notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
English Voiceover: 
Added immersive English voiceovers for dialogues and hints.

Localization Expansion: 
Added support for 15 new languages: Arabic, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.

Gameplay Enhancements:
Improved gameplay mechanics for a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
UI Improvements: Enhanced the main menu UI for better navigation and visual appeal.

Player Controller Update: 
Optimized player controls for greater precision and responsiveness.
Bug Fixes: Addressed minor issues to ensure a polished gaming experience.
